notes.title: Major update WIP
notes.content:
Hello, I figured I should let ya'll know that I have a major update already in the works, in case anyone cares. 😳 But since I barely have any time to get to work on it and it's on low priority on my to-do list, it's moving slow. I want to make this new update right and final before I work on my new game project, so I will not be rushing it this time.

In the meantime, here's some of the things that are either already done or that will be included in the update:
[list]
[*] Visual improvements
[*] Better looking, more interesting environments
[*] Audio Drive mode
[*] Environment reacting and changing to background music in any game mode
[*] "Neon" environment/visuals
[*] Removed the often confusing teleporting to catch up to other players feature
[*] Higher player limit and more lobby options
[*] More game options
[*] More optimizations and overall quality improvements
[*] Player kicking feature and host force game start button
[*] Cleaner UI
[*] And likely more unforeseen and unmentioned things added/changed throughout development
[/list]
